dedupe_keys.name: lidar based tree models for munich germany 2012

description: Markus Münzinger and the Leibniz Institute of Ecological Urban and Regional Development publish LiDAR-based tree models for Munich using observations from 2012. Registered metadata describes tree positions, heights, crown diameters, crown outlines and CityGML LoD2 vegetation objects. The workflow identifies vegetation above two metres from a canopy-height model at a 0.5-metre grid and represents crowns with geometric primitives. These properties support spatial simulations involving urban green infrastructure and provide vegetation components for the TUM2TWIN city environment. Coverage is Munich, Germany; the resource is a historical observation, not a current tree inventory. Provider metadata identifies version 1.0 and a 2025 release. Access requires registration at the IOER Research Data Centre. CC BY 4.0 is stated alongside restricted-access metadata; free descriptive access does not establish unrestricted file access. Caveats include automated tree reconstruction and the difference between acquisition year and release year. The separate 2022 tree-model record represents another time slice. Only registered descriptive metadata and native catalogue links were reviewed; no tree models were downloaded.
